verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents conversation checkpointing to save and resume complex sessions, and it runs without setup in browser-based Cloud Shell. Together these give a glancing basis for picking work back up later, but nothing shows a session started on one device can be continued on another device or in a browser. Missing for 10: documented cross-device session sync or handoff, a web/browser continuation of CLI sessions, and hands-on corroboration of resuming a checkpoint elsewhere.
